subject.title: fix: stop retrying nonexistent amazon order items

question: Should Amazon shipment `NonexistentOrderItem` failures be terminal/manual for both OrderSell recovery crons?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes operational recovery semantics in a way CI cannot validate: matching orders will no longer be reopened automatically.

options.title: Accept terminal/manual behavior
options.body: Merge the current approach so permanent Amazon rejections stop burning retries and remain documented for operators.

options.title: Narrow the exclusion
options.body: Limit the behavior to a more specific marketplace or reason format if maintainers think other matching cases should still auto-retry.

options.title: Use capped retry instead
options.body: Keep automatic recovery but add a retry cap or manual-action marker before excluding the order permanently.

recommendation.title: Accept terminal/manual behavior
recommendation.body: Merge the current approach so permanent Amazon rejections stop burning retries and remain documented for operators.

likelyOwner.reason: Marcos is the requested reviewer and has the strongest visible prior signal on the related Amazon NonexistentOrderItem flow.
